messages:
cleo: Heads-up — ATS rotation job just moved a batch of candidates into the "US-experience" bucket that should've been marked "EMEA-only". I'm seeing interviewers in EMEA getting assigned. Anyone else seeing this?

sara: saw it in my queue, 6 candidates. noticed timezone mismatch in the rotation rules yesterday.

jon: ats-bot reported a successful run at 07:00 UTC with rule id 42. I pulled the job logs, looks like the predicate that checks office_region was accidentally swapped with experience_level in latest deploy.

ats-bot: [deploy-bot] Rotation job 42 completed in 3.2s. changeset: rotate-buckets-v2.4

mike: Not good — those EMEA interviews require local data consent for recordings. We need to pause assignments ASAP.

cleo: Agreed. jon — can you pause the rotation job and backfill reassignments? If we can't, let's roll the change back.

jon: pausing now.

jon: /ats pause-job 42

ats-bot: Job 42 paused (requested by jon) — next run cancelled.

jon: I can run a targeted reassign script to move affected candidates back to EMEA bucket. Will take ~15–20 min.

sara: Please do. Also flag interviewers who've already received invites so we can cancel and re-send with correct timezone.

jon: Running SQL to find affected candidates:

```
SELECT id, candidate_email, assigned_interviewer_id
FROM candidates
WHERE bucket = 'US-experience' AND created_at >= '2026-02-25' AND source_job_id = 42;
```

jon: Found 6 rows. Kicking off reassign job and notifying interviewers.

cleo: Great. Can we also add a guard to the rotation job to ensure region predicate is checked before bucket change? File a ticket if needed.

jon: Yep — opening ticket now. #jira RADAR-1187

mike: For the ones with invites already sent — Recruiting ops, please cancel invites and confirm before we re-send.

sara: On it. I'll DM interviewers and cancel pending invites. Will send updated invites once jon confirms reassign.

jon: Reassign script finished. All 6 candidates moved back to EMEA bucket. I updated the interview assignments: 4 had pending invites, 2 not yet scheduled.

ats-bot: Audit event: candidate_bucket_change {6 items} by jon at 2026-03-08T09:22:30Z

cleo: Thanks. jon, please include the patch for the predicate check in your PR and request a quick review from eng-ops.

jon: PR created: github.com/redwood/ats/pull/489 — includes a pre-check and a rollback hook in case of mismatches.

cleo: Can we also add an alert in monitoring if rotation job changes > 3 buckets in a single run? This seems like a good SLO.

jon: Good call. Adding metric: rotation.bucket_changes and a monitor with threshold 3.

sara: All invites cancelled and interviewers informed. Recruiters notified candidates affected with apology + new timeline.

mike: Thanks team. Follow-up: can we add a short training note in interviewer onboarding about verifying candidate region before accepting? Might reduce downstream risk.

cleo: I'll add a 1-pager to interviewer-onboarding and schedule a brief sync next week.

sara: copied, will include in next week's interviewer newsletter.

cleo: Closing loop — job paused, reassignment done, PR + monitor + onboarding note created. I'll mark the incident resolved after 24h of no regressions.

jon: noted.

sara: thanks all :thumbsup:
